title: Do plants have per­son­al­it­ies?
titleZh: 植物之间，也有“性格分化”吗？
summary:
生态学家不会在心理学意义上使用“个性”一词，但研究人员越来越意识到，即便属于同一物种，不同植物个体在生长模式——以及应对胁迫的反应——上，也会表现出稳定的差异。加拿大麦克马斯特大学植物生态学家苏珊·达德利表示：“我的理解是，植物更像是运行着软件的计算机。不同的环境，筛选出了不同的程序设定。”

来源：BBC Wildlife；作者：Molly Helfend；原文发布时间：2026-06-06 20:40:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Eco­lo­gists wouldn’t use the word ‘per­son­al­ity’ in a psy­cho­lo­gical sense, but research­ers are recog­nising that indi­vidual plants within the same spe­cies can show con­sist­ent dif­fer­ences in how they grow – as well as how they respond to stress. “My men­tal model is that plants are closer to com­puters run­ning soft­ware,” says Susan Dud­ley, a plant eco­lo­gist at McMas­ter Uni­versity in Hamilton, Canada. “Dif­fer­ent envir­on­ments select for dif­fer­ent pro­gram­ming.”
paragraphs.contentZh: 生态学家不会在心理学意义上使用“个性”一词，但研究人员越来越意识到，即便属于同一物种，不同植物个体在生长模式——以及应对胁迫的反应——上，也会表现出稳定的差异。加拿大麦克马斯特大学植物生态学家苏珊·达德利表示：“我的理解是，植物更像是运行着软件的计算机。不同的环境，筛选出了不同的程序设定。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Dud­ley says the meta­phor can help research­ers think about plant strategies, but notes that plants oper­ate very dif­fer­ently from anim­als. In that way, the meta­phor of per­son­al­ity has entered eco­lo­gical dis­cus­sion, being referred to as ‘intraspe­cific trait vari­ation’. “With plants, we can test this dir­ectly,” says Dud­ley. “We see that both genet­ics and envir­on­ment shape how indi­vidu­als respond to the world around them.”
paragraphs.contentZh: 达德利表示，这一比喻有助于研究人员理解植物的生存策略，但她同时强调，植物的运作机制与动物存在很大差异。由此，个性这一隐喻进入了生态学讨论，被称为“种内性状变异”。达德利指出：“在植物身上，我们可以直接验证这一点。我们发现，基因和环境共同塑造着植物个体对周围世界的响应机制。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Stud­ies pub­lished in journ­als such as Eco­logy Let­ters and Nature Eco­logy & Evol­u­tion have shown that indi­vidu­als of the same spe­cies can pre­dict­ably dif­fer in growth rate, nutri­ent use and tol­er­ance to drought or shade. For example, some plants will con­sist­ently invest heav­ily in rapid growth and repro­duc­tion while oth­ers alloc­ate more resources to dur­ab­il­ity and defence. You can observe ver­sions of this in your home and garden. Some house­plants wilt dra­mat­ic­ally the moment they miss a water­ing, while oth­ers remain steady for days. Some seed­lings race towards the light then col­lapse in heat, while oth­ers grow slowly but retain their struc­ture through times of stress.
paragraphs.contentZh: 发表在《生态学快报》和《自然·生态与进化》等期刊上的研究表明，同一物种的不同个体在生长速度、养分利用以及对干旱或荫蔽的耐受能力上，都会表现出可预测的差异。例如，有些植物会持续将大量资源投入快速生长和繁殖，而另一些则把更多资源用于提升耐久性与防御能力。在家中或花园里，你就能看到这种现象。有些室内植物一次漏浇就会明显萎蔫，而有的则能好几天都维持原状。有的幼苗趋光生长迅速，遇到高温却倒伏；有的虽长势缓慢，却能在胁迫环境下保持形态稳定。

paragraphs.contentEn: This pat­tern aligns with what eco­lo­gists call the ‘leaf eco­nom­ics spec­trum’: a global frame­work described in the journal Nature that shows plant spe­cies fall­ing along a con­tinuum from ‘fast’ strategies, such as rapid growth but short-lived, nutri­ent-rich leaves, to ‘slow’ strategies char­ac­ter­ised by tougher, longer-lived foliage and con­ser­vat­ive water use. Think of the dif­fer­ence between nettles and sun­flowers, which shoot up quickly in open ground, and holly and hawthorn, which invest in dense, dur­able leaves built to last. Research sug­gests that sim­ilar trade-offs that sit at dif­fer­ent points along that strategy spec­trum can also occur within a spe­cies.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这种现象与生态学家所说的“叶经济谱”相吻合：《自然》期刊曾刊文介绍过这一全球性框架，指出植物物种分布于一条连续的策略谱系上，一端是“快”策略，表现为生长迅速、叶片寿命短且养分含量高；另一端则为“慢”策略，其特点是叶片更坚韧、寿命更长且水分利用更为保守。以荨麻、向日葵与冬青、山楂的区别为例：前者能在开阔地带迅速拔高，后者则选择将资源倾注于构建致密耐久、能够长期存续的叶片。研究表明，这种位于策略谱系不同位置的类似权衡，在同一物种内部也同样存在。

paragraphs.contentEn: This mat­ters as envir­on­mental stress doesn’t affect all organ­isms equally. Con­ser­vat­ive plants may sur­vive bet­ter in a drought, whereas faster-grow­ing spe­cies may dom­in­ate in wet­ter years. This internal diversity can buf­fer pop­u­la­tions against extreme weather and envir­on­mental change, shap­ing which plants per­sist and which dis­ap­pear. Plants also adjust to their sur­round­ings, bend­ing towards light, alter­ing root growth in response to neigh­bours and increas­ing chem­ical defences after herb­i­vore attack, finds work pub­lished in Eco­logy Let­ters.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这一点意义重大，因为环境胁迫对不同生物的影响并不均等。采取保守策略的植物在干旱条件下具有更高的存活率，而生长更快的物种则可能在降雨充沛的年份占据优势。这种种群内部的多样性能够缓冲极端天气和环境变化带来的冲击，进而决定哪些植物能存续，哪些会消失。此外，发表在《生态学快报》上的研究发现，植物也会根据周围环境调整自身行为：它们会向光弯曲生长，会根据邻近植物调整根系生长，并在遭受植食动物攻击后增强化学防御能力。

paragraphs.contentEn: The eco­lo­gist Richard Kar­ban, whose research helped estab­lish the field of plant beha­vi­oural eco­logy, says these responses reflect how act­ively veget­a­tion can mon­itor its sur­round­ings. “Plants are con­stantly gath­er­ing inform­a­tion from their envir­on­ment and adjust­ing their beha­viour in response,” he says. “They are far more aware of their sur­round­ings than people once thought,” he con­tin­ues. “They respond to scents in the air, the col­our of light, who their neigh­bours are, and even insects walk­ing across their leaves.” So, while plants don’t have per­son­al­it­ies, they do exhibit con­sist­ent strategies in how they grow, com­pete and sur­vive. This, in turn, high­lights something import­ant: that vari­ation within spe­cies is part of how life adapts and endures.
paragraphs.contentZh: 生态学家理查德·卡尔班的研究推动了“植物行为生态学”这一领域的建立，他表示，这些反应体现出植物在监测周围环境时的高度主动性。他说：“植物不断从环境中获取信息，并据此调整自身行为。”他进一步解释道：“它们对周围环境的感知程度，远远超出人们过去的想象。空气中的气味、光线的颜色、临近的其他物种，甚至爬过叶片的昆虫，都会引发它们的反应。”因此，尽管植物并不具备心理学意义上的个性，但每株植物在生长、竞争和生存方式上，确实表现出稳定的策略。这也进一步揭示了一个重要事实：物种内部的变异，是生命适应环境、繁衍存续的重要组成部分。
